newsitem.title: USA: Amer Home Products rises on Alheimer report.
newsitem.headline: Amer Home Products rises on Alheimer report.

text.p: Shares of American Home Products Inc rose 1-1/8 to 67-7/8 on Monday on a report that the anti-infalmmatory pain-killer ibuprofin reduced the probability of getting Alzheimer's disease.
On Monday, scientists from the National Institute on Aging and Johns Hopkins University said they found that ibuprofin reduced the likelihood of getting the disease.

Ibuprofin, which is manufactured by American Home Products' Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories division, is also made by Johnson & Johnson's McNeil Consumer Products Co and by Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc, a unit of Mylan Laboratories Inc.
Share of Johnson & Johnson traded up 3/8 to 61 in afternoon trade.
Shares of Mylan Labs traded up 3/8 to 17-1/4.
